instruction: Can you load and play this video stream? https://playertest.longtailvideo.com/adaptive/bipbop/gear4/prog_index.m3u8
source: JW Player test streams - commonly used HLS test content

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using JW Player test stream. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric with URL validation. Similar single-step streaming task as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator checks both that VLC is playing AND that the specific URL is loaded
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] directly, matching what get_rule() returns
Robust URL matching logic: Handles multiple XML path variations and HLS stream edge cases (e.g., VLC showing just filename instead of full URL)
Proper state extraction: Getter correctly fetches VLC HTTP status interface and saves XML for metric parsing
Appropriate edge case handling: Handles URL parsing errors, missing XML elements, and different URL representations gracefully
No postconfig needed: VLC HTTP interface remains accessible throughout evaluation, no timing issues
